consequence.statement: New optional way to set keystore passwords; existing Certificates that use passwordSecretRef are not described as affected.

assertion.statement: Certificate resources can now set JKS/PKCS12 keystore passwords as literal values, mutually exclusive with the existing passwordSecretRef field; this is an opt-in addition.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the evidence does not name the new literal-password field, and the change covers both the JKS and PKCS12 keystores, so it maps to two schema paths whose spelling is not stated; applicability: this is an additive opt-in feature; the evidence describes no environment state that makes it apply, and the new field path is not named
